study: WS-D MEG multichannel study (meg_z): semi-synthetic injection into measured ds000117 magnetometer noise
status: DEV DEFAULTS - NOT FROZEN. Every value may change during development on the 4 dev subjects only and is finalised at D4 (design Part D, runbook 6.2-6.5). This file never authorises a confirmation run.

dataset.license_note: snapshot 2.0.0 dataset_description.json: "License": "CC0" (not CC BY 4.0); cite Wakeman & Henson (2015) and the snapshot DOI

subjects.rule: dev = 4 lowest-numbered analysed subjects; confirmation = other 12 (fixed before download)

preprocess.bads: union of channels.tsv status=bad over the six runs (and info['bads'])

selection.statistic: RMS over the 0..T-1 sample post-onset window of the baseline-corrected evoked field

noise_windows.note: contiguous non-overlapping windows inside each gap (dependence measured at D2, F9); the gap may contain the circle/fixation transients of the trial (inter-stimulus activity, disclosed; G3 is an effect-size gate)

preprocess.sampling_note: 1100 Hz / 12 = 91.667 Hz; T = 20 samples = 218.2 ms window duration (samples at 0 ... 207.3 ms after the corrected onset); C = 24 magnetometers (review b/d, F2)
preprocess.stim_check_rule: refuse the subject unless every run has STI101, the same number of stimulus events in events.tsv and STI101 (mask 255), and every lag <= 1.5 raw samples (F8)

reference_metric.certificate: B_dagger = lambda_min(Sigma_K^{1/2} Sigma_ref^{-1} Sigma_K^{1/2}) * B_cert(K_G), Sigma_K = flip-flop Kronecker fit of the same run 1-2 statistics, K_G = Sigma_K^{-1/2} R_s Sigma_K^{-1/2}; |B_cert(K_G)| <= 1e-10 x max(1, tr K_G) is set to exactly 0 (scale-relative cut; the raw residue is stored as B_cert_KG_raw)
reference_metric.note: Ledoit-Wolf full Sigma_ref (runbook); the Kronecker reference is computed only as a descriptive sensitivity (protocol variant with kind = kronecker_flipflop)

G2.spread_rule: max whitened eigenvalue <= spread_ratio_max x Marchenko-Pastur upper edge (1 + sqrt(d/n))^2 and min >= MP lower edge (1 - sqrt(d/n))^2 / spread_ratio_max; threshold set from dev only (F10)

G3.rule: gate: max over partitions, alignments (preceding / next onset) and tiling positions of the debiased whitened energy mu^T Sigma_ref^{-1} mu - tr(Sigma_ref^{-1} S)/n of the positional mean < 1% of trace_K_target; significance tests (max-t, Hotelling) on gap means are reported, not gating (F3, F9)
G3.alignment_note: rposition (aligned to the next onset) is accurate to within one window: slots are tiled from the preceding onset

dependence.statistic: whitened lag-one cross-covariance of consecutive windows of one gap (training)

E1.budget_rule: a confirmation subject whose training, calibration or evaluation pool is below the frozen grid need (4 N*_A,s <= training pool; m_hi <= calibration; n_eval <= evaluation), or without a theta_s root, or without restart agreement at theta_s, is excluded and counts toward the 10-subject minimum (F5, review c)

signal.theta_note: fixed certificate grid for PZ1 only; the fitted geometries are theta = 0 (control) and the per-subject theta_A,s and theta_B,s of the population rule
signal.trace_K_scale: latent variances fixed per subject so that tr K = trace_K_target at theta = 0; NOT rescaled per theta (review c)

population.path: general (physical product class under Sigma_ref^{-1}); pinned Y19/TR09 path only for the Kronecker sensitivity
population.restart_agreement: all starts reach the best value, or >= 75% of starts within 1e-9 of it

learners.recipe: T25 science: moments (fitted mean, divisor N), starts (HOSVD + 3 random), structured (NFPA, physical product Grassmannian), unrestricted (EMPCA population form), map_for; intercept b = (I - A) mean

flag_rule.rule: record optimization-limited iff the selected NFPA restart ended iteration_limit, OR ended line_search_stopped with normalised gradient norm > 1e-6 (100 x the recipe tolerance), OR the restart clean-risk spread >= |D|; the unchanged T25 rule (selected restart not stationary, or spread >= |D|) is recorded alongside as optimization_limited_t25_rule; the T25 optimizer is byte-identical

max_iter_rule.rule: D4 decision rule: raise max_iter from 6000 to 12000 iff the dev pilot shows iteration_limit on more than 1% of selected restarts (all arms); otherwise keep 6000

definitions.clean_ref: mean over the n_eval fixed evaluation records of (A x + b - s)^T Sigma_ref^{-1} (A x + b - s)
definitions.clean_ref_semi_analytic: exact in the Gaussian signal law, empirical evaluation-noise mean and covariance (t25.science.risks)
definitions.clean_euclidean: as clean_ref with the identity metric
definitions.readout: GLS (Sigma_ref^{-1}) least-squares amplitudes of the reconstruction on the 6 templates; NMSE of alpha_11 and alpha_21

inference.unit: subject: mean over resamples of D = risk(F) - risk(U)
inference.interval: approximate simultaneous Bonferroni Student-t over subjects

reading_rules.PZ1: every included subject: B_dagger(theta = 0) = 0 exactly and B_dagger strictly increasing over the fixed theta grid {0, 0.12, 0.25, 0.40}; a_best(theta = 0) = 0 (tolerance zero_tol x max(1, tr K)) as a consistency check (predictions file)

PZ2.rule: per geometry: the cells with grid factor <= 1/2 are below and >= 2 above (the relative grid is round(f N*_s), N* from a_best with restart agreement in every subject); a geometry is APPLICABLE iff it has >= 1 below and >= 1 above cell and every included subject has restart agreement; an applicable geometry is MET iff every below cell is decided negative and every above cell decided positive
PZ2.overall: MET iff both geometries A and B are applicable and MET; NOT APPLICABLE iff neither is applicable; otherwise NOT MET (the reason - a geometry not applicable or not met - is reported)
PZ2.descriptive: the B_dagger interval [N*, (c_U - c_F)/B_dagger - 1] per subject

PZ3.rule: theta = 0 control (absolute grid): no decided positive class contrast at any N

PZ4.rule: interaction I_m = D(est_m) - D(ref) averaged per subject over the A and B cells: decided negative at m_lo for both estimators and |mean I_hi| < |mean I_lo| for both
PZ4.note: estimators are LW / flip-flop MLE, not T25 estimate

PZ5.rule: isotropic negative control: R_iso - R_ref (primary score), per class (U and F), averaged per subject over all cells of all geometries, decided positive for both classes (2 tests)
PZ5.descriptive: the class contrast under the isotropic metric is reported, not registered (review e)

reading_rules.family: ref-arm cells of the control, A and B geometries (PZ2/PZ3) + 4 PZ4 tests + 2 PZ5 tests
reading_rules.descriptive: every other arm/contrast/score with the same interval construction
prestated_reasons_for_a_PZ2_miss: dependence of contiguous windows (D2 dependence statistic)

power_rule.rule: expected half-width at the bracket-adjacent N < 1/2 |predicted contrast a + B/N|; else raise R (max 50) or narrow the family; never add subjects

calibration.rule: m_hi = 1024 if every dev subject has >= 1.1 x 1024 calibration windows, otherwise 768; fixed at D3 from the dev subjects and frozen at D4

theta_rule.rule: P = smallest dev training pool (fixed at D3, frozen at D4); N*_A = floor(P/5), N*_B = max(5 n_min, N*_A/2); per subject theta_A,s and theta_B,s solve N*_pred,s(theta) = target by a 1-D root search (brentq on log N*) on population quantities only, before any fit; final constants at theta_s with all starts; relative grids {1/4, 1/2, 1, 2, 4} N*_s (round half up)

arms_note: calibration-arm estimators are Ledoit-Wolf full and the Kronecker flip-flop MLE, NOT T25 science.estimate; the calibration interaction is therefore not byte-comparable with T25 (review f, Q8)
guards: preprocess, gates, population and secondary_d8 refuse confirmation subjects unless the kit protocol.json exists, is frozen and equals the loaded protocol, and no --protocol file was given; the runner additionally requires --confirmation and --protocol-sha256
